notes: FORMAT EXAMPLE ONLY - values are illustrative and are NOT reconciled against any source. Do not ingest this file as evidence-grade data. A real vendored set (D-29) must reconcile every action across at least two independent public sources (issuer distribution notices, exchange corporate-action feeds), name them in each entry's `sources`, and use its own `dataset` name. Each `action` object is exactly the stored form in docs/DATA_PROVENANCE_SPEC.md section 5, validated on ingest by the same parser the read path uses. `announcedAt` is optional; the repository forbids availableAt earlier than the ex/effective date, so an announcement before the ex-date is clamped up to the ex-date start and absent means 'available at the ex-date start'. An entry naming fewer than two sources is flagged UNVERIFIED_SINGLE_SOURCE on ingest.
